title: ISIN lookup UX + form consolidation + auto-fetch consent - U1-U6 upgrades, 6 legacy removals, months readouts
derived_from: Locked DESIGN-LOCKED document #281 (backend as-is to-be U1-U6 + 6 removals), finding history #279 (option C, full-fact popup, model B refined, local-first rule) and #280 (duplicate-field D1-D4); developer confirmed 2026-11-17. Documentation only, zero new decisions (Stage 2 rule). Visual design: src/design/d279_isin_fetch_ux.html (dev, 5 sections).

requirements.text: The ISIN lookup SHALL run in-page from the Add-bond form via a JSON lookup endpoint (client fetch(), same service.lookup() logic) - no full page navigation.

acceptance_criteria.given: the Add-bond form with a typed ISIN
acceptance_criteria.when: the user leaves the ISIN field or taps the lookup button
acceptance_criteria.then: the lookup runs via fetch() and the page performs no navigation (URL unchanged, scroll and keyboard state kept)

requirements.text: After the user presses Apply on the Fetched-details popup, the popup SHALL stay closed - an applied marker per ISIN SHALL suppress popup restore-on-load on subsequent renders; without Apply the popup still shows on GET /watch?isin=.

acceptance_criteria.given: Apply was pressed for ISIN X
acceptance_criteria.when: the page re-renders (server GET /watch?isin=X or any reload)
acceptance_criteria.then: the Fetched-details popup stays hidden for ISIN X

acceptance_criteria.given: Apply was never pressed for ISIN X
acceptance_criteria.then: the Fetched-details popup shows (server-render guard preserved)

requirements.text: Lookup SHALL answer local-first: session cache, then persisted bond_master (fetched_at freshness), then bundled snapshot - instantly, with zero cooldown and no official-network call.

acceptance_criteria.given: ISIN X exists in bond_master or the bundled snapshot
acceptance_criteria.then: facts return immediately from the local source with no cooldown countdown and no NSDL/RBI/NSE/BSE request

requirements.text: The 60s cooldown gate SHALL apply only before an official check (NSDL to RBI to NSE to BSE); the countdown UI SHALL appear only in the rate-limited official state - never on a local answer.

acceptance_criteria.given: a local answer is available
acceptance_criteria.then: no cooldown gate and no countdown UI are shown

acceptance_criteria.given: a local miss within 60s of a previous official check
acceptance_criteria.then: the cooldown gate runs before the official collect and the countdown UI shows the remaining seconds

requirements.text: The lookup response SHALL carry all resolved facts with per-field sources (snapshot: company/coupon/maturity; NSDL: rating/agency/issuer/secured/cycle); the popup SHALL show 8 facts with per-field source labels, 3 facts offline, and unpublished fields stay editable.

acceptance_criteria.given: a full online answer for ISIN X
acceptance_criteria.then: 8 facts show, each labelled with its per-field source

acceptance_criteria.given: offline (official sources unreachable) with local data
acceptance_criteria.then: only the 3 snapshot facts show and unpublished fields remain editable in the form

requirements.text: Add bond form SHALL no longer collect or require invested/qty/price (money trio removed, removals 1-3); the server SHALL accept POST /watch without them - DB columns watch_investment/qty stay unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.given: the Add-bond form renders
acceptance_criteria.then: no invested/qty/price inputs exist

acceptance_criteria.given: POST /watch without invested/qty/price
acceptance_criteria.then: the watch candidate is created with no required-field error

acceptance_criteria.given: existing bond rows
acceptance_criteria.then: watch_investment/qty columns still exist and prior values are intact

requirements.text: Move form end date SHALL default from the candidate's maturity_date - the typed end-date input is removed (removal 4); it appears only when maturity_date is missing.

acceptance_criteria.given: a watch candidate with maturity_date M
acceptance_criteria.then: end date is M and no end-date input shows

acceptance_criteria.given: a watch candidate without maturity_date
acceptance_criteria.then: an end-date input shows as the fallback

requirements.text: Move interest start date SHALL default to the purchase date and stay editable; the bare-required validation on interest start SHALL be removed (removal 5).

acceptance_criteria.given: purchase date P chosen in the Move form
acceptance_criteria.then: start_date defaults to P and remains editable

acceptance_criteria.given: start_date left at the default
acceptance_criteria.then: the move succeeds with no separate interest-start entry required

requirements.text: Move broker SHALL be optional - prefill kept, required validation dropped (removal 6).

acceptance_criteria.given: the Move form with a prefilled broker
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clears broker and submits
acceptance_criteria.then: the move succeeds

requirements.text: The Add response SHALL include a server-computed months_remaining anchored at today (maturity, cycle); the client SHALL update the readout live on date or cycle change - one engine, src/maturity.py.

acceptance_criteria.given: the Add form with a maturity date and chosen payout cycle
acceptance_criteria.when: the user changes the date or cycle
acceptance_criteria.then: the months-remaining readout recomputes live (anchored at today) without a page reload

requirements.text: The Move response SHALL include the purchase-anchored months readout months_remaining(purchase, maturity, cycle) from the same engine (src/maturity.py).

acceptance_criteria.given: purchase date P, maturity M, cycle C
acceptance_criteria.when: the Move form renders or the dates change
acceptance_criteria.then: the readout equals the src/maturity.py engine output anchored at P and updates live

requirements.text: On first app open a one-time auto-fetch consent dialog (Auto-fetch / Not now) SHALL show; the choice SHALL be recorded (auto_fetch_prompted) so the dialog never shows again.

acceptance_criteria.given: a fresh install with no auto_fetch_prompted flag
acceptance_criteria.then: the consent dialog shows exactly once

acceptance_criteria.given: the dialog was answered (either choice)
acceptance_criteria.then: the dialog does not show again

requirements.text: Settings SHALL carry the auto-fetch toggle (auto_fetch_enabled, default OFF) plus Last synced and Sync now.

acceptance_criteria.given: default state after install
acceptance_criteria.then: the auto-fetch toggle reads OFF, Last synced shows the last real pass time (or never synced), and Sync now is available

requirements.text: The 12h counter SHALL start only after opt-in; enabled and due runs one silent pass with the stamp written only after a real pass; toggle OFF skips auto-fetch entirely.

acceptance_criteria.given: opted in and last stamp older than 12h
acceptance_criteria.then: one auto-fetch pass runs and the stamp updates after the pass completes

acceptance_criteria.given: auto_fetch_enabled is OFF
acceptance_criteria.then: no auto-fetch runs and no stamp is written

requirements.text: Financial goal select at Move SHALL stay permanent and the portfolio detail goal display read-only - design-only item (U7), zero backend change.

acceptance_criteria.given: the Move form and the portfolio detail page
acceptance_criteria.then: the goal select is present at Move and the goal shows read-only in detail; existing goal tests still pass

prd_items.statement: The ISIN lookup SHALL run in-page via a JSON endpoint (fetch(), no page reload) reusing the same service lookup logic.
An applied marker per ISIN SHALL keep the Fetched-details popup closed after Apply, while the server-render guard still shows it when Apply was never pressed.
prd_items.decision_id: Discussion #281 - decision 1 (option C: A as guard) / U1

prd_items.statement: Lookup SHALL answer local-first from session cache, persisted bond_master and the bundled snapshot - instant, zero cooldown.
The 60s cooldown SHALL gate only the official check; countdown UI only in the rate-limited state, never on local data.
The popup SHALL show 8 facts with per-field source labels, 3 facts offline, unpublished fields editable.
The Add form SHALL drop the money trio (invested/qty/price) - facts only at watch stage; DB columns unchanged.
The Move end date SHALL derive from maturity_date - typed input removed (fallback only when maturity missing).
The interest start SHALL default to the purchase date, stay editable, with the bare-required validation removed.
The Move broker SHALL be optional - prefill kept, required dropped.
The Add form SHALL show a today-anchored months-remaining readout computed by the server and updated live.
The Move form SHALL show the purchase-anchored months-remaining readout from the one engine src/maturity.py.
The app SHALL ask auto-fetch consent once on first open (Auto-fetch / Not now) and record auto_fetch_prompted.
Settings SHALL hold the auto-fetch toggle (default OFF) plus Last synced and Sync now.
The 12h counter SHALL start only after opt-in; stamp written only after a real pass; OFF skips auto-fetch entirely.
The goal select stays permanent at Move and read-only in detail - design-only, zero backend change (U7).

test_cases.title: In-page lookup without navigation (ILF-01)
test_cases.steps: 1. Open Add-bond form. 2. Type ISIN. 3. Blur the field / tap lookup. 4. Instrument navigation (URL, history, reload count).
test_cases.expected: Lookup completes via fetch(); URL and history unchanged; no page reload; form state preserved

test_cases.title: Popup stays closed after Apply (ILF-02)
test_cases.steps: 1. Lookup ISIN X. 2. Press Apply - popup closes. 3. Trigger re-render (GET /watch?isin=X and blur/reload paths). 4. Repeat with Apply never pressed.
test_cases.expected: Popup stays hidden after Apply for ISIN X; popup still shows on fresh GET when Apply was never pressed

test_cases.title: Local-first answer, zero cooldown (ILF-03)
test_cases.steps: 1. Seed ISIN X in bond_master and one ISIN only in the snapshot. 2. Run lookup for both. 3. Count outgoing official-source requests and watch for countdown UI.
test_cases.expected: Both answers return locally and instantly; zero official requests; no countdown UI

test_cases.title: Cooldown gates only the official check (ILF-04)
test_cases.steps: 1. Local hit - run lookup. 2. Local miss within 60s of an official check - run lookup. 3. Observe gate order and countdown UI.
test_cases.expected: Local hit: no gate, no countdown. Local miss: 60s gate before official collect with countdown UI shown

test_cases.title: Full-fact popup with per-field sources, offline 3 facts (ILF-05)
test_cases.steps: 1. Full online answer - inspect popup. 2. Simulate offline (official unreachable) with local data - inspect popup. 3. Inspect unpublished fields.
test_cases.expected: Online: 8 facts each with source label (snapshot: company/coupon/maturity; NSDL: rating/agency/issuer/secured/cycle). Offline: only 3 snapshot facts; unpublished fields editable

test_cases.title: Money trio removed from Add (ILF-06)
test_cases.steps: 1. Render Add-bond form. 2. POST /watch without invested/qty/price. 3. Inspect schema and an existing row.
test_cases.expected: No trio inputs in the form; POST succeeds without required-field error; watch_investment/qty columns intact with prior values

test_cases.title: Move end date derives from maturity (ILF-07)
test_cases.steps: 1. Candidate with maturity_date - open Move. 2. Candidate without maturity_date - open Move.
test_cases.expected: With maturity: end = M, no end-date input. Without maturity: end-date input shows as fallback

test_cases.title: Interest start defaults to purchase (ILF-08)
test_cases.steps: 1. Choose purchase date P in Move. 2. Inspect start_date. 3. Edit start_date, then submit with default. 4. POST /watch/<id>/move without touching start.
test_cases.expected: start_date defaults to P, stays editable; submit with default succeeds (no bare-required error)

test_cases.title: Broker optional at Move (ILF-09)
test_cases.steps: 1. Open Move with prefilled broker. 2. Clear broker. 3. Submit.
test_cases.expected: Prefill shows; cleared broker submits successfully

test_cases.title: Add months-remaining readout live (ILF-10)
test_cases.steps: 1. Open Add with maturity + cycle. 2. Compare readout to src/maturity.py output anchored at today. 3. Change date and cycle.
test_cases.expected: Readout matches the engine (today-anchored) and recomputes live on each change, no reload

test_cases.title: Move months-remaining readout purchase-anchored (ILF-11)
test_cases.steps: 1. Open Move with purchase P, maturity M, cycle C. 2. Compare readout to src/maturity.py(purchase, maturity, cycle). 3. Change dates.
test_cases.expected: Readout equals the engine output anchored at P and updates live

test_cases.title: One-time auto-fetch consent dialog (ILF-12)
test_cases.steps: 1. Fresh state (no auto_fetch_prompted). 2. Open app - dialog appears. 3. Answer either choice. 4. Reopen app twice.
test_cases.expected: Dialog shows exactly once; never again after answering (either choice)

test_cases.title: Settings toggle default OFF with Last synced + Sync now (ILF-13)
test_cases.steps: 1. Default state - open Settings. 2. Inspect toggle, Last synced, Sync now. 3. Run Sync now. 4. Reopen Settings.
test_cases.expected: Toggle OFF by default; Last synced shows last real pass (never synced initially); Sync now runs a pass and refreshes Last synced

test_cases.title: 12h counter after opt-in, OFF skips (ILF-14)
test_cases.steps: 1. Opt in, set last stamp older than 12h - open app. 2. Set toggle OFF - open app. 3. Inspect stamps.
test_cases.expected: Opted-in: one pass runs, stamp written after the pass. OFF: no pass, no stamp written

test_cases.title: Goal select permanent, detail read-only (ILF-15)
test_cases.steps: 1. Open Move - inspect goal select. 2. Open portfolio detail - inspect goal display. 3. Run existing goal test suite.
test_cases.expected: Goal select present at Move; goal read-only in detail; existing goal tests pass unchanged

changelog.note: First suite: ILF-01..ILF-15 from discussion #281 locked document (U1-U6 + 6 legacy removals + U7 design-only), finding locks on #279/#280. 15 requirements, 22 acceptance criteria, 15 test cases, full RTM bindings. Documentation only, zero new decisions.
